object.description: Setup: fresh install. Steps: 1. Open Settings and note the selected accent colour. 2. Select each of the six accent colours in turn. 3. Go to the Home screen after each selection. Expected: Lime is selected on a fresh install. Exactly six accent colours (Lime, Tangerine, Electric, Magenta, Amber, Violet) are offered, and the Home screen highlight colour changes to match each selection.
